items.headline: About $600M in Long Positions Liquidated as Bitcoin, Ether Drop
items.summary: Traders betting on higher prices lost $599 million in 24 hours as Bitcoin and Ethereum fell to their lowest levels in nearly three months. Longs accounted for 88% of $680.81 million in total crypto liquidations.
items.sourceTitle: Nearly $600 Million in Crypto Longs Liquidated as Bitcoin and Ethereum Fall to August Lows

items.headline: Bitcoin Falls to Around $70,600 Amid Extended Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin slid to about $70,600 as its four-week decline deepened. Coinbase also hit a fresh 28-day low, and ether kept trailing bitcoin over one- and four-week periods.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Sinks to $70,600 as Four-Week Losses Deepen

items.headline: Visa to Settle Stablecoin Transactions Using Western Union's USDPT
items.summary: Anchorage Digital is working with Visa so that certain stablecoins issued by its federally regulated bank, beginning with Western Union's USDPT, can serve as settlement assets on Visanet.
items.sourceTitle: Visa Adds Western Union’s USDPT for Stablecoin Settlement via Anchorage

items.headline: Aave user loses $305,000 in Across Protocol website hijack
items.summary: A user reportedly lost about $305,000 from an Aave deposit token after the Across Protocol website was hijacked. Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery estimates total losses of roughly $401,900 across nine wallets.
items.sourceTitle: Aave user loses $305,000 after Across Protocol website hijack

items.headline: Binance says hacked assets are covered; proof pending
items.summary: Binance says it has closed the remaining gap in customer backing. Users will need to wait for cryptographic proof of a new snapshot before they can verify it.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Says Hack Assets Covered, Reserve Proof Pending

items.headline: Sky advisor suggests pausing new borrowing from core vaults
items.summary: BA Labs, a Sky advisor, has proposed stopping new borrowing from core vaults, which would leave existing borrowers able to repay and manage collateral but not mint more. The report cites 771 open vaults holding about 376.33 million USDS in debt.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Advisor Proposes Halting New Core Vault Borrowing

items.headline: New York regulator sets 2027 deadline for crypto marketing rules
items.summary: New York's financial regulator will require BitLicense holders and crypto trust companies to prepare annually approved marketing policies. The policies are to cover risk disclosures, paid promoters and misleading claims, with a May 2027 deadline.
items.sourceTitle: NYDFS Sets May 2027 Deadline for Crypto Ad Policies

items.headline: New York regulator issues crypto advertising guidance for firms
items.summary: The New York Department of Financial Services has released guidance setting out what it expects crypto firms to do when creating policies and procedures for advertising and marketing.
items.sourceTitle: NYDFS sets fresh advertising standards for crypto firms

items.headline: DOJ, Banks and DeFi Groups Back Suit Against Illinois Crypto Tax
items.summary: The Justice Department, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition including a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap have filed briefs supporting a lawsuit seeking to invalidate Illinois' 0.2% tax on digital asset transactions.
items.sourceTitle: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi

items.headline: Crypto industry says Illinois crypto tax can't be enforced as written
items.summary: Crypto industry groups have filed opposition in a court challenge to a crypto transaction tax in Illinois, arguing the tax would not work in practice.
items.sourceTitle: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court

items.headline: Bitcoin dominance tests 61% level; altcoin impact discussed
items.summary: Bitcoin's market dominance is testing a 61% breakout level, and a weekly Supertrend indicator has flipped bullish. The piece looks at what this could mean for altcoins.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Dominance Tests 61% Breakout, and That's Bad News for Altcoins

items.headline: Solana Company posts Q3 revenue rise on staking rewards
items.summary: Solana Company, a digital asset treasury firm, reported quarterly revenue of $3.4 million, up from $697,000 a year earlier. The company's growth was linked to staking rewards.
items.sourceTitle: ‘Milestone quarter’: Solana Company reports Q3 revenue growth driven by staking rewards

items.headline: Large Bitcoin holders accumulate as ETF investors pull out funds
items.summary: Glassnode data through November 9 shows a narrow pattern of whale accumulation, while Bitcoin ETF sessions through November 10 still recorded outflows.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin whales stack coins while ETF investors dump millions daily

items.headline: Zcash Slides Under $965 After 26% Weekly Drop
items.summary: Zcash's seven-day decline was about three times larger than bitcoin's. The token now trades roughly 43% below its late-September level.
items.sourceTitle: Zcash Falls Below $965 as Weekly Loss Reaches 26%

items.headline: Bitcoin Heads for First Back-to-Back Annual Losses
items.summary: Bitcoin is on track for two consecutive years of losses, which would break a long-running pattern of annual gains. The excerpt notes that the data contains some nuance.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Faces First Back-to-Back Annual Losses in History, But There's a Catch

items.headline: Bitcoin Recovers Above $74,000 Following Inflation-Driven Dip
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $74,600 after falling to $72,787 when U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected. Market-wide liquidations totaled $199 million, with $51 million tied to bitcoin.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Price Reclaims $74K After CPI Sell-Off Sparks Volatility

items.headline: Stablecoin supply shrinks by $14.2 billion, largest drop since 2022
items.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell by $14.2 billion, the steepest contraction since the 2022 downturn. USDT and USDC together dropped by nearly $11 billion over the past month, while gold-backed tokens stayed flat.
items.sourceTitle: Stablecoin supply drops $14.2 billion in largest contraction since 2022 bear market

items.headline: Helius Unveils Privacy Rings Protocol for Solana Transactions
items.summary: Solana Privacy Rings are a protocol from Helius that encrypt balances and transfer amounts while keeping activity on the Solana network. The piece explains how the system works and how it compares to alternatives.
items.sourceTitle: What Are Solana Privacy Rings? Inside Helius’ Privacy Protocol for Solana

items.headline: LlamaRisk Suggests Borrow Rate Limits for Aave V3
items.summary: Risk firm LlamaRisk has proposed timed borrowing buffers for Aave V3, alongside a steward-managed route for large clients. The parameters are still provisional, and governance votes have not yet taken place.
items.sourceTitle: LlamaRisk Proposes Borrowing Speed Limits for Aave V3

items.headline: Apex Group joins Hedera Council, eyeing tokenization and settlement
items.summary: Apex Group, which oversees $3.5 trillion in assets, has joined the Hedera Council. It plans to explore Hedera for tokenization, compliance and settlement.
items.sourceTitle: Apex Group joins Hedera Council to explore tokenization and settlement

items.headline: Bitcoin Core patches high-severity bug that could halt mining
items.summary: Bitcoin Core developers have fixed three bugs, including a serious one that could stop miners from building new blocks. The flaws involve denial-of-service and privacy issues rather than theft of coins.
items.sourceTitle: A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix

items.headline: Pyth Network brings NYSE stock and ETF data to marketplace
items.summary: Pyth Network has added real-time stock and ETF data from the New York Stock Exchange to its data marketplace.
items.sourceTitle: Pyth Network adds NYSE stock and ETF data to its marketplace

items.headline: Bitcoin steadies near $74K as stocks gain amid yield rise
items.summary: Bitcoin moved within a tight band while investors bought dips in tech shares. Meanwhile, US bond yields rose after inflation data came in high.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound

items.headline: StoneX keeps Buy rating on Securitize, citing tokenization growth
items.summary: StoneX reaffirmed its Buy recommendation on Securitize, pointing to tokenized equities, fund demand and structured credit as drivers of growth. The brief is based on a short excerpt, so further details are not covered here.
items.sourceTitle: StoneX sees 111% upside for Securitize shares as tokenization revenue rebounds

items.headline: Solana perpetuals volume jumps 65% as spot trading shrinks
items.summary: Perpetual futures trading on Solana has surged, with one venue making up about 77% of weekly turnover in DefiLlama's Solana data. The growth comes as stablecoin market capitalization declines.
items.sourceTitle: Solana perp volume explodes 65% amid shrinking spot activity

items.headline: LNbits issues urgent patch following reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.summary: The LNbits project warned that installations on older versions are vulnerable and advised operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.
items.sourceTitle: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts

items.headline: Former Ripple CTO says no hidden XRP plan exists
items.summary: David Schwartz, Ripple's CTO Emeritus, told frustrated XRP holders that the token's price mostly tracks the broader market. He said there is no secret plan behind XRP.
items.sourceTitle: Ripple Ex-CTO Tells Angry XRP Holders There’s No Secret Plan

items.headline: Ether Dips Near $2,000 as Stakers Hold Firm
items.summary: Ether briefly fell toward $2,000 after hotter-than-expected US inflation data unsettled markets, then recovered to around $2,060. Staking data shows investors showing little interest in withdrawing their staked ETH.
items.sourceTitle: Ethereum Price Fell 20%, But Stakers Are Refusing to Sell

items.headline: Major Banks Put $270M Behind Stablecoin Issuer Project
items.summary: Goldman Sachs, Citi and other global banks have committed $270 million to a U.S.-incorporated stablecoin issuer codenamed Project Faro. The funding covers five years of operations as traditional lenders seek to compete with Tether and Circle.
items.sourceTitle: Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants

items.headline: Mercado Bitcoin restores cash withdrawals following $49M hack
items.summary: Brazilian exchange Mercado Bitcoin will let customers deposit and withdraw cash via the country's instant payment system starting next week. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
items.sourceTitle: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack

items.headline: Ether, Solana and XRP fall as $580M in liquidations hit
items.summary: Major altcoins such as Solana and XRP dropped on Coinbase spot markets, with Solana trading under $82 and XRP under $1.05. Bitcoin also extended its decline below $73,000.
items.sourceTitle: Ether, SOL and XRP Slide as Liquidations Hit $580 Million

items.headline: Banks Reportedly Back Stablecoin Venture With $270 Million
items.summary: Banks have reportedly committed $270 million to a stablecoin issuer. The funding would cover five years of operations, and the consortium is targeting a first-half 2027 launch of a dollar stablecoin.
items.sourceTitle: Banks Commit $270 Million to Stablecoin Venture: Report

items.headline: Polymarket's US exchange volume climbs despite mounting regulatory scrutiny
items.summary: Trading volume on Polymarket's US exchange rose from June to October, driven largely by sports betting. The platform is facing growing regulatory scrutiny.
items.sourceTitle: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles

items.headline: Altcoin speculation peaked as Bitcoin hit near $87,000
items.summary: According to Glassnode, altcoin speculation reached a high around the time Bitcoin peaked near $87,100. Short-term holders are now selling most tokens at a loss.
items.sourceTitle: Altcoin Speculation Peaked With Bitcoin Near $87,000, but Recent Buyers Now Sell at Losses

items.headline: Bitcoin eyes U.S. inflation data as analysts question relief rally
items.summary: Bitcoin is trading under $75,000 ahead of October inflation figures. Analysts say a lasting recovery would need better liquidity and spot ETF demand, not just short-term macro relief.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough

items.headline: IRS Sends Tax Letters to Crypto Users, Adviser Says
items.summary: Cryptotaxaudit's CEO says the IRS is running a letter campaign urging crypto taxpayers to review past filings. He added that receiving a letter does not by itself indicate wrongdoing.
items.sourceTitle: IRS Is Sending Crypto Users Tax Letters—Here’s What You Need to Know

items.headline: Buterin Faces US Lawsuit Over Ethereum Foundation Firing
items.summary: Vitalik Buterin is facing a US lawsuit that alleges the Ethereum Foundation dismissed a cancer patient who led an internal staff revolt. The case is tied to a dispute known as the Ethereum 'suicide pledge' row.
items.sourceTitle: Vitalik Buterin Sued in Ethereum ‘Suicide Pledge' Row

items.headline: Wall Street Pushes Tokenization, but Buyer Demand Is Uncertain
items.summary: Tokenization is growing quickly, with banks and asset managers showing interest, yet beyond tokenized stocks it remains unclear whether anyone will buy such products. Issuing an asset as a token does not guarantee demand.
items.sourceTitle: Wall Street Wants to Tokenize Everything. But Who’s Buying?

items.headline: XRP's euro cash-out route showed under €100 of direct liquidity
items.summary: A November 8 ledger snapshot showed only 96.80 EURGH available to direct XRP sellers, highlighting a conversion limit ahead of GateHub's announced SEPA redemption.
items.sourceTitle: XRP’s new euro cash-out route had less than €100 in its direct market

items.headline: Solana Company Plans Hong Kong Expansion Focused on Tokenization
items.summary: The Solana Company, which holds 2.2 million SOL, is targeting Hong Kong for expansion as the city prioritizes tokenization in its fintech development. The move could grow its headcount to 30 to serve local banks.
items.sourceTitle: The Solana Company Targets Hong Kong for Massive APAC Expansion

items.headline: Crypto Liquidations Top $855M as Bitcoin Dips Below $74K
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped toward $74,000 late Sunday, touching $73,708, its lowest since August, as forced selling spread through markets. Ethereum fell to $2,100, and CoinGlass recorded $855.69 million in liquidations over 24 hours.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Liquidations Surge as Bitcoin Falls Below $74K. How Bad Is It?

items.headline: Threshold says tBTC bridge resumed onchain, app still paused
items.summary: Threshold reports that the tBTC bridge has restarted onchain, while its app stays paused. An Aave tBTC reserve on Ethereum remains frozen as more operators are expected to reconnect.
items.sourceTitle: Threshold Says tBTC Bridge Has Resumed Onchain, but App Remains Paused

items.headline: AVAX Drops 28% Over Four Weeks, Trailing Bitcoin and Ether
items.summary: AVAX fell 28% over four weeks, underperforming Bitcoin and ether, which lost 11.3% and 16% respectively over the same period. The token gave back earlier relative gains.
items.sourceTitle: AVAX Falls 28% in Four Weeks, Lagging Bitcoin and Ether

items.headline: Crypto Market Gives Back Post-Election Gains as Bitcoin, XRP Fall
items.summary: The crypto market swung sharply in early November, briefly adding about $100 billion after the U.S. midterm elections before losing those gains amid a global tech stock sell-off.
items.sourceTitle: Weekly Report: Crypto Market Erases $100B Rally as Bitcoin, XRP Prices Slide

items.headline: Bitcoin Developer Proposes Collateral Rule to Deter Quantum Attacks
items.summary: Developer Cory Fields has proposed requiring future quantum attackers to post bitcoin as collateral before accessing vulnerable wallets. Owners who prepare could recover their coins and receive a penalty payment.
items.sourceTitle: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet

items.headline: Daily roundup of key crypto news and events
items.summary: A daily digest covering crypto market trends, events, DeFi, Web3 and regulation developments.
items.sourceTitle: Here’s what happened in crypto today

items.headline: Binance and OKX leaders exchange barbs over user losses
items.summary: Binance co-founder Yi He responded to OKX CEO Star Xu with a complaint about stuck tokens, after Xu had criticized Binance's UID transfer setup. The exchange leaders are trading public jabs.
items.sourceTitle: Binance and OKX Bosses Trade Jabs Over User Losses

items.headline: Sky's TVL drops 15% weekly as USDS supply shrinks
items.summary: Total value locked in the Sky protocol fell 15% over the past week, while USDS circulating supply declined to $5.59 billion. Sky.money currently lists a 3.80% savings rate set by governance.
items.sourceTitle: Sky TVL Falls 15% in a Week as USDS Supply Contracts

items.headline: Ripple CEO Says XRP Remains Company's Core Focus
items.summary: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse reaffirmed XRP as the company's north star, tying RLUSD expansion and business integration to more liquidity and utility for the token. His strategy aims at more payments and institutional activity across the XRP ecosystem.
items.sourceTitle: XRP Is Ripple’s North Star: CEO Centers Strategy on ‘Things That Are Good for XRP’

items.headline: EU Creates Crypto Task Force to Stop Russian Sanctions Evasion
items.summary: The European Union is setting up a dedicated crypto task force within a new sanctions office to coordinate national authorities. It aims to stop evasion of sanctions using digital assets, including networks such as A7 that offered a digital ruble stablecoin.
items.sourceTitle: EU Deploys Dedicated Crypto Task Force to Block Russian Evasion

items.headline: Bitcoin Trails Restaurant Chain Stocks Over Six Months
items.summary: Bitcoin's price has declined over the past six months, lagging several restaurant chain stocks, though it still outperformed Nvidia's shares.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin and Nvidia are Losing to Restaurant Chain Stocks in 2026

items.headline: Greece Passes Crypto Tax Law with 10% Gains and 15% DeFi Levies
items.summary: Greece's parliament has approved a tax framework setting a 10% rate on crypto capital gains and 15% on income from staking, lending and DeFi. It marks the country's first comprehensive treatment of digital asset taxation.
items.sourceTitle: Greece Approves 10% Crypto Gains Tax, 15% Levy on Staking and DeFi Income

items.headline: Aave Labs Buys Avon Team to Build Fixed-Rate Lending
items.summary: Aave Labs has acquired the Avon team, which brings its lending protocols and onchain order book. No first market or launch date has been announced yet.
items.sourceTitle: Aave Labs Acquires Avon Team to Develop Fixed-Rate Lending

items.headline: US Treasury Severs Crypto Exchange MEXC From American Financial System
items.summary: FinCEN has ordered U.S. institutions to stop all transfers to and from MEXC, which Treasury says facilitated $16 billion in illicit finance linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia. The action is part of Operation Economic Outcast.
items.sourceTitle: Treasury Cuts Crypto Exchange MEXC Off From US Financial System

items.headline: US Imposes Sanctions on 45 More Prince Group-Linked Targets
items.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC has sanctioned additional offshore companies and associates it says helped Prince Group executives conceal assets and evade earlier sanctions. The action targets an alleged crypto scam network.
items.sourceTitle: US Sanctions 45 More Targets Tied to Alleged Crypto Scam Empire Prince Group

items.headline: Thai regulator files criminal complaint against Bitget operator
items.summary: Thailand's SEC has lodged a criminal complaint against BG Limited, the operator of Bitget, over alleged unlicensed trading in Thailand from 2022 to 2025. The move comes ahead of a planned December 5 access block.
items.sourceTitle: Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block

items.headline: Gnosis Pay says hackers accessed some customer data
items.summary: Crypto card provider Gnosis Pay said attackers got into customer information on a legacy system behind its branded cards. Funds were not affected, and its enterprise card platform was not touched.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data

items.headline: Binance severs ties with SignalPlus after fake Teams invite hack
items.summary: Binance cut off trading platform SignalPlus following a breach that began with a fraudulent Microsoft Teams invitation. SignalPlus later reported losses below $82,000 and said reimbursement is underway, while Deribit also disabled connected keys.
items.sourceTitle: Binance cuts off trading platform SignalPlus after hackers break in with a fake Teams invite

items.headline: Strive posts $509M Q3 profit on bitcoin gains
items.summary: Strive reported a profitable third quarter driven by bitcoin gains, with its bitcoin holdings reaching 43,124 BTC. Its shares continued to decline over the period.
items.sourceTitle: Strive’s bitcoin gains drive $509 million Q3 profit as BTC buying ramps up

items.headline: US Retirement Rule Allowing Crypto in 401(k)s Nears Completion
items.summary: A final rule permitting crypto in 401(k) retirement plans is under White House review, and the timing for savers to access it is in focus. Details on when this could happen are not provided here.
items.sourceTitle: Trump’s Plan to Let 401(k)s Hold Crypto Is Almost Final: When Can Savers Buy In?

items.headline: Optimism proposal would reduce Security Council authority over standalone chains
items.summary: A proposed policy would let qualifying transfers move forward without another governance vote, changing how users depend on parties for network upgrades. The change concerns the Optimism ecosystem's governance.
items.sourceTitle: Optimism new proposal weakens council power over standalone chains

items.headline: Bitrue Rebrands Around Bitrue AI, Moving Beyond Its XRP Focus
items.summary: Crypto exchange Bitrue announced a brand shift placing Bitrue AI at the center of its identity. The company is moving from being known mainly for XRP trading toward an AI-focused crypto platform.
items.sourceTitle: Bitrue Pivots To AI With Bitrue AI, Building On Its XRP Roots

items.headline: Ripple-backed XRP treasury firm Evernorth shares fall sharply after listing
items.summary: Evernorth, backed by Ripple, has dropped nearly 47% since its October Nasdaq listing. A new filing shows 73.7 million shares that holders could resell, raising concerns about possible selling pressure.
items.sourceTitle: Nasdaq's XRP Treasury Crashed Nearly 50% In a Month

items.headline: Eric Trump-Linked American Bitcoin Reports $126M Profit, Shares Fall
items.summary: American Bitcoin Corp., a bitcoin miner co-founded by Eric Trump, posted about $126 million in third-quarter net income after prior losses. The Nasdaq-listed firm holds 8,427 BTC, though its mining costs rose and its shares dropped.
items.sourceTitle: Eric Trump’s American Bitcoin Banks $126M Profit—But ABTC Shares Dive

items.headline: Amundi launches tokenized equity index fund on Ethereum
items.summary: Europe's largest asset manager, Amundi, has tokenized an equity index fund on Ethereum. The new share class gives blockchain-based exposure to an index covering 600 companies across European markets.
items.sourceTitle: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum

items.headline: Hong Kong to require crypto providers to track customer trades
items.summary: Covered crypto providers will have to collect transaction information starting in 2027, ahead of the tax department beginning international information exchanges under CARF in 2028.
items.sourceTitle: Hong Kong forces crypto providers to track customer trades

items.headline: Trump Media shifts $342M in bitcoin to Crypto.com
items.summary: Blockchain data tracked by Arkham shows a wallet linked to Trump Media sent a large bitcoin transfer to Crypto.com. The amount is reported as $342 million.
items.sourceTitle: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show

items.headline: Nearly $1B in Crypto Liquidations as Bitcoin Rises 4.6%
items.summary: Crypto liquidations totaled $974.80 million over 24 hours as prices climbed, with most losses hitting traders betting on declines, per Coinglass. Bitcoin rose 4.64% to $80,480.
items.sourceTitle: Nearly $1 Billion in Crypto Liquidations Hit as Bitcoin Jumps 4.6%

items.headline: Crypto Groups Challenge Illinois' 0.2% Crypto Tax in Court
items.summary: Crypto industry groups are seeking to have Illinois' 0.2% levy struck down. The tax would be based on asset value rather than gains, and covered brokers would have to collect it from customers.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto Groups Seek to Strike Down Illinois’ 0.2% Tax

items.headline: Coinbase Opens Deribit Derivatives to US Prime Institutional Clients
items.summary: Institutional clients in the US can now reach global derivatives through Coinbase Financial Markets. The excerpt notes that shared liquidity does not mean a single margin pool.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase Brings Deribit Options and Perpetuals to US Prime Clients

items.headline: Bitcoin climbs back above $80,000 as oil falls sharply
items.summary: Bitcoin has regained the $80,000 level while US oil prices dropped about 12% following a Democratic win in Congress. The report also notes factors that could reverse both moves.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Reclaims $80,000 as Oil Price Drops Sharply

items.headline: Zcash grants committee scraps plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC
items.summary: The Zcash grants committee has withdrawn its proposal to send 98,000 ZEC toward future mining rewards after community pushback. Competing proposals remain on the table, one to end its funding and another to keep the existing grants system.
items.sourceTitle: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards

items.headline: ZachXBT names French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa in $133M crypto theft
items.summary: On-chain investigator ZachXBT has identified Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the alleged victim of a theft he estimates at over $133 million. The bank had not issued a public statement when the report was written.
items.sourceTitle: ZachXBT Tracked a $133M Crypto Theft for Two Days. Then He Named the Victim

items.headline: Bitcoin rebounds from seven-week low as Democrats sweep Congress
items.summary: Bitcoin dipped to a seven-week low of $75,618 as crypto long liquidations approached $300 million over 24 hours. The article links the price move to the Democratic sweep of Congress.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin bounces from 7-week low under $76K as Democrats sweep Congress

items.headline: 1inch lawyer expects US agencies to shape crypto rules amid midterms
items.summary: A 1inch lawyer says US regulatory agencies are likely to drive crypto policy regardless of how the midterm elections turn out. The excerpt gives no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold

items.headline: Experts Say Payments Could Give Crypto Super Apps Daily Use
items.summary: At TOKEN2049 Singapore, panelists from firms including MetaMask, Trezor and WalletConnect discussed whether payments could make crypto an everyday financial service. The debate centred on everyday use rather than trading.
items.sourceTitle: Payments Could Give Crypto Super Apps a Daily Use Case, TOKEN2049 Experts Say

items.headline: Moscow Exchange Sets Dec. 1 Start for Crypto Trading
items.summary: Russia's Moscow Exchange has announced it will begin cryptocurrency trading on December 1, offering bitcoin, ether and USDT. The exchange described it as the country's first organized digital currency market.
items.sourceTitle: Moscow Exchange Confirms Dec. 1 Crypto Trading Launch With Bitcoin, Ether, USDT

items.headline: RUNE gains 15% as THORChain resumes most swaps after pause
items.summary: THORChain has restored trading on Bitcoin, Ethereum and several other networks after a refund bug halted activity. Three chains remain paused.
items.sourceTitle: RUNE rallies 15% as THORChain restarts most swaps after halt

items.headline: Dormant Bitcoin Wallet Activity Slows Again in October
items.summary: Long-dormant bitcoin wallets moved about 2,159 BTC last month, a second straight monthly decline. Wallets from 2013 accounted for much of the activity, while addresses from the earliest years were largely absent.
items.sourceTitle: October’s Dormant Bitcoin Awakenings Cool as Transfers Plunge 81% From August

items.headline: Traders Worry About Democratic Midterm Sweep Ahead of Election Day
items.summary: Crypto traders are reportedly concerned that Democrats could win a midterm sweep, with Ohio's outcome seen as significant. The excerpt also points to a Bitcoin price level being watched during the anxiety.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin's Election Day Panic: Crypto Traders Fear a Democratic Midterm Sweep
